title: Claude Code launch template
description: One JSON object a home keeps by its SHA-256 and renders into the files a Claude Code launch needs (HOME-002 R1). Nothing in it is interpreted, expanded or executed; the transcript slot is filled by resuming the rendered file by path with --fork-session.

harness.description: The harness this template renders for.

flags.description: The extra Claude Code arguments the launch line carries, in order.

slots.description: The five slots, all required; a slot outside them is refused by name.

transcript.description: How this harness fills the transcript slot: the rendered file resumed by path.

canon.description: A canon file whose examples render first, or null.

mcp.description: Written verbatim as the MCP configuration file; carries mcpServers.

env.description: Environment variable name to string value.

secrets.description: Secrets by handle. A use-only secret is written as its handle and nothing else; a readable secret is refused until SECRETS-002 builds the reader.

reader.description: The broker reader's command mapping, in text; empty until the secrets rows fill it, and never substituted into a launch line by HOME-002.

instructions.description: The text appended to the system prompt.

env.description: The environment variable the secret fills.

handle.description: The handle the door swaps for the credential.
